pull.title: KAFKA-21377: Use effective min ISR in TopicCommand min-ISR filters
pull.body:
Ref : https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-21377

--under-min-isr-partitions and --at-min-isr-partitions compared the ISR
size with the raw min.insync.replicas, while the broker
(Partition#effectiveMinIsr) and controller cap it at the replica count.

For topics with min.insync.replicas > replication factor the CLI listed
healthy partitions as under min ISR and missed them as at min ISR.

Behaviour before and after the fix, with ELR enabled/disabled.

```
1. RF=2, min.insync.replicas=3, ISR=2, ELR enabled
     - Broker: UnderMinIsr=0, AtMinIsr=1, acks=all write accepted
     - 4.4.0 CLI: listed by --under-min-isr-partitions, not by
--at-min-isr-partitions
     - Fixed CLI: listed by --at-min-isr-partitions only

2. RF=1, min.insync.replicas=2, ISR=1, ELR disabled
     - Broker: UnderMinIsr=0, AtMinIsr=1, acks=all write accepted
     - 4.4.0 CLI: listed by --under-min-isr-partitions, not by
--at-min-isr-partitions
     - Fixed CLI: listed by --at-min-isr-partitions only

3. Control: RF=3, min.insync.replicas=3, one follower stopped (ISR=2)
     - Broker: acks=all write fails with NotEnoughReplicasException
     - 4.4.0 CLI and fixed CLI: both list it under
--under-min-isr-partitions
```

```
 --under-min-isr-partitions, 4.4.0 CLI:
          Topic: minisr-gt-rf     Partition: 0    Leader: 3
Replicas: 3,1   Isr: 3,1
          Topic: rf1-minisr2      Partition: 0    Leader: 2
Replicas: 2     Isr: 2
  --under-min-isr-partitions, fixed CLI:
          (empty)
  --at-min-isr-partitions, fixed CLI:
          Topic: minisr-gt-rf     Partition: 0    Leader: 3
Replicas: 3,1   Isr: 3,1
          Topic: rf1-minisr2      Partition: 0    Leader: 2
Replicas: 2     Isr: 2

```

issue.title: KAFKA-21266: Compute the effective min ISR from the target partition

repository.name: kafka
repository.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

issue.body:
The controller used the replica count of partition 0 to compute the
effective min ISR for every partition of a topic. Partitions can have
different replication factors, so a small partition 0 could lower the
min ISR of other partitions and clear their ELR too early.

This patch uses the replicas of the partition being changed. All callers
already have that partition.

The test helper `newAlterPartition` always used partition index 0. It
now uses the given partition.
